target: Spoiler-free 100% completion of the original mobile release, including every room pickup, supply, file, weapon, puzzle, and the complete single campaign route

areas.name: Original Mobile Route and Save Safety
areas.location_cue: The Java mobile title menu and its single New Game slot.
areas.note: Preserve the retired original build and its only save.

levels.1: This compact adaptation has its own rooms and puzzles.
levels.2: Run the original 2008 mobile-phone release on compatible preserved hardware.
levels.3: Use the original Java/mobile package as the content authority, verify movement and targeting keys, and avoid substituting another version of the first game because Genesis rearranges its map and puzzle inventory.

levels.1: The in-game slot cannot preserve branches or mistakes.
levels.2: Close the game and copy its save data before each major door or puzzle.
levels.3: Exit through the game menu, duplicate the full application-data folder with a physical-area label, reopen the active copy, and confirm Continue loads. Restore only while the application is closed.

levels.1: Explore every physical room before entering the last secured chamber.
levels.2: Finish the single playable route after collecting every listed file, item, weapon, and supply pickup.
levels.3: Keep the pre-cavern backup, open the final secured room only after the mansion checklist is complete, finish the remaining encounters, and let the closing sequence return to the title menu.
